web_summary: iuvui combines package-grade consistency with source-level control. Install components your way, keep custom variants, and stay connected to upstream improvements.
web_package_mode_description: Use the maintained runtime in your application.
web_source_mode_description: Install component source directly into your project.
web_model_title: One specification. Two ways to work.
web_canonical_source_description: Shared behavior, anatomy, variants, and contracts.
web_npm_package_description: A maintained runtime published by iuvui.
web_registry_source_description: Component code owned and customized by your team.
web_styles_description: Precompiled foundations, semantic variables, and component recipes.
web_icons_description: A coherent visual language with typed React exports and precise imports.
web_lifecycle_description: Registry provenance and upgrade paths that respect locally owned variants.
web_promise_description: Your product should remain adaptable as its UI dependencies evolve.
web_promise_api: Public APIs do not leak implementation primitives.
web_promise_contracts: Package and source modes share the same contracts.
web_promise_variants: User-owned variants are never silently overwritten.
web_promise_core: Pro products extend the system without closing the core.
web_footer_description: Built in public for long-lived products.
